sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression confirmed by surface detection assay in Expi293F cells (PMC10156119); no functional assay for PRLHR specifically reported in this library paper.
sites.rationale: PRLHR is a GPCR whose N-terminus (residues 1–60) is extracellular and whose C-terminus is intracellular; the N-terminus is therefore the sole extracellular terminus, making insert_after_residue=0 the topology-derived junction. The paper names no specific residue, but for a GPCR the N-terminal prepend is the only possible extracellular placement, so the position is unambiguous. Computed: residue 1 = M, TM1 begins at residue 61, giving 60 residues of extracellular space between the tag junction and the first TM helix, well above the ≥3-residue minimum. The exogenous HA signal sequence is cleaved post-translationally, leaving FLAG displayed on the cell surface. PMC10156119 describes a 215-member GPCR library in which PRLHR/GPR10 is engineered as a full-length, membrane-anchored FLAG-GPCR-1D4 construct. The FLAG tag (DYKDDDDA) is placed after an exogenous HA signal sequence (MKTIIALSYIFCLVFA) and before GPCR residue 1, so after signal-peptide cleavage the FLAG is exposed at the extracellular N-terminus. Constructs were expressed in Expi293F cells and confirmed for surface detection.

sources.claim: Each GPCR construct includes an N-terminal FLAG tag and a C-terminal 1D4 tag, except for four GPCRs belonging to the Frizzed (FZD) subfamily, which have an N-terminal HA (hemagglutinin) epitope tag and a C-terminal 1D4 epitope tag.

literature_notes: L1 and L2 both derive from PMC10156119 and describe the same FLAG-GPCR-1D4 construct; L1 is cited as the primary clip because it explicitly states surface detection. The C-terminal 1D4 tag co-engineered in the same construct is intracellular (residues 339–370 are all intracellular per the topology landmarks) and is therefore recorded in other_positions only. No ledger line supports an internal extracellular-loop insertion for PRLHR, so no internal sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: The C-terminal 1D4 tag in the FLAG-GPCR-1D4 construct is appended after residue 370, which lies within the intracellular C-terminal region (339–370); it is not an extracellular surface-tag site.
